title: Manufacturing Operations Director
text:
The Figeac Aero Group has multiple locations across the world. Figeac Aero North America, located in Wichita, Kansas in the heart of the country, is a leading aerospace partner for detailed parts and sub-assemblies with specialization in saturation shot peening, shot peen forming, chemical processing, painting, assembly, non-destructive testing, and machining.

At Figeac Aero North America, we place a high value on our employees. Employees are given the opportunity to be a part of something special while achieving their career goals. We offer competitive compensation as a smaller company in addition to an attractive benefits package for qualified employees.

***Manufacturing Operations Director***

***Salary:*** *$90,000 - $120,000*

***Shift:*** *Monday to Friday 1st shift*

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Manages and directs all manufacturing and production activities including shift quality and quality of work
* Monitors overall plant performance for production and comply with all quality standards
* Familiarity with AS9100, NADCAP & ISO9001 standards & audits
* Works with multiple cross functional groups (Quality, Scheduling, Assembly, Procurement, Supply Chain, Facilities/Maintenance, etc.)
* Reviews production and operating reports and resolves operational/manufacturing problems to ensure minimum costs and prevent operational delays and to meet future growth.
* Uses problem-solving skills and analytical abilities to develop innovative and expedient solutions
* Applies Lean principles and production metrics to make informed decisions and drive continuous improvement processes
* Lead and motivate team members to achieve company/department goals while providing direction, development and leadership to production management team
* Provides training, problem solving, and interpersonal skills to diminish conflict and handle employee issues
* Works overtime and occasional weekend shifts as required to support production needs.
* Ensure ITAR/EAR restriction and regulations are followed

**Education/Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and 5 years management experience in manufacturing environment; or 8+ years related management experience and training in a manufacturing environment 2
* 2+ years’ experience in aerospace industry
* CNC machining experience required
* Knowledge of NDT, paint, and chemical processing required
* Strong business acumen with proven leadership skills
* Full knowledge and adherence to ITAR/EAR restrictions and responsibilities

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism and confidentiality
* Mandatory background in an aerospace or manufacturing environment required.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including interpersonal, negotiation & conflict resolution.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Expert in all Microsoft Office 365 applications and knowledge of ERP programs preferred
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Self-motivated, innovative, practical, and adaptable
* Ability to speak, read, write, and understand English language
* Must be 18 years or older
* Must be a US citizen or legally authorized to work in the United States, not eligible for VISA sponsorship

**Working Conditions:**

* The essential duties job may require the ability to stoop; to reach; to stand,
* to walk and sit for extended periods of time;
* to push and/or pull objects weighing up to 30 pounds;
* to lift and carry objects weighing up to 15 pounds;
* to use finger dexterity to operate a computer and other office equipment and hand strength to grasp files and other objects;
* to perceive the attributes of objects by touch;
* to hear and verbally exchange ideas and information with the public, staff and others on the phone and in the office.
* Occasionally being on foot, bending, stooping, squatting, kneeling, climb stairs and kneeling and/or crouching to retrieve files and other items.
* Occasionally Lifting and carrying (with assistance) items weighing 20-50 lbs.

**Competitive Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance with competitive rates
* Company paid life & AD&D insurance
* Corporate YMCA memberships
* Paid Time Off
* Generous 401(k) with company match
* Life Insurance, AD&D, Disability & Voluntary options
* Employee Assistance Plan

Figeac Aero North America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
